description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'Smarty_CacheResource' which specifies the interface and some common functionality for cache resource handlers used in the Smarty templating engine. It includes method declarations for cache handling operations such as reading, writing, clearing, and locking caches, along with some static properties for plugin management.

classes.name: Smarty_CacheResource
classes.description: An abstract class defining the interface and common methods for cache resource handlers in Smarty.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populate cached object with metadata from resource.

methods.name: populateTimestamp
methods.description: Populate cached object with timestamp and existence info from resource.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Process the cached template, typically reading headers and content.

methods.name: writeCachedContent
methods.description: Write the rendered template output to cache.

methods.name: getCachedContent
methods.description: Retrieve cached content if available, capturing output buffer.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clear cache for a specific resource.

methods.name: locked
methods.description: Check if cache is locked, waiting for release if necessary.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Load a cache resource handler based on type or default configuration.
